title: open/1: the text the Drawing editor reads for a structure file
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli mol open` (always JSON); `text` is the file decoded as UTF-8 (binary CDX as base64), `changes` lists each change made to it, in this order: `charset` (the file was UTF-16, with or without a byte-order mark, or 8-bit text), `replaced` (characters not valid in that charset became U+FFFD), then `empty` (attributes with an empty value dropped from the CDXML start tags). Each fix carries only its own fields. A file over 8 MiB is refused with an error/1 (`error.open.tooBig`). Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/chem/structure_file.rs.

charset.description: the charset the text was decoded as: UTF-16, UTF-16LE or UTF-16BE (the last two when there was no byte-order mark), or the charset the XML declaration named, windows-1252 when it named none or one with no table

count.description: how many invalid sequences became U+FFFD

names.description: the attribute names dropped, each once, in order of first sight
